audit.whatIsWrong: diffRating 8.5/10 and 'Hard matchup' overstate a 49.61% win rate — this is a near-coinflip lane that is his early and yours from first item.
audit.why: 770 games at 49.61% is even-to-slightly-unfavoured, not an 8.5/10 nightmare. The prose already describes a lane that flips to Gangplank on the Sheen spike.
audit.corrected: Difficulty 7/10, still HARD in the early phase but not a lost lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart was inverted against the entry's own prose: it gave Gangplank level 1 while whys[0] and the early text both say 'Levels 1-3 are his', and gave Olaf the first-item and 2-item stages while whys[4] says the first-item spike 'flips the lane in your favor' and whys[6] calls full items 'genuinely even'.
audit.why: Olaf's Undertow-retrieve pattern beats a keg-less Gangplank at 1-2; the Sheen-empowered Parrrley into a chained keg out-trades his axe throws from first item on; at full items Ragnarok still lets a fed Olaf run you down, so it settles even.
audit.corrected: Chart rewritten as one group: L1 Olaf 3/10, L2 Olaf 3/10, L3 Skill 5/10, L4-5 Skill 5/10, L6 Gangplank 7/10, First item Gangplank 7/10, 2+ items Skill 5/10.
sources: currentText.whys[0], whys[1], whys[2], whys[4], whys[6], early

audit.whatIsWrong: Ragnarok is repeatedly described as 'cleanses CC', and Undertow's armour reduction is never mentioned at all. No cooldowns are given for either.
audit.why: Riot's R text is 'immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking' — a conditional immunity that ends when he stops swinging, which is a different and more exploitable thing than a cleanse. Riot's Q text: 'reducing their Armor and Move Speed... If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reset', so the axe both shreds your armour and can come back well inside its 9s.
audit.corrected: R restated as disable-immunity while he keeps attacking (100/90/80); Q given its armour shred and pick-up reset; E Reckless Swing given its 11/10/9/8/7 true-damage cadence.

audit.why: Anti-heal early is correct and important — Berserker Rage gives him life steal scaling off missing Health, so he gets more sustain exactly when your poke has him low.

edits.before: Q-poke costs him HP and pays you gold. Identify how Olaf contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: He throws Undertow, picks the axe back up, and walks you down before a keg can zone him. Last-hit at Parrrley's tip.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Olaf carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Kegs one-shot from range, but a fed Olaf under Ragnarok still runs you down. Even at full items — never fight him alone.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 8.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Ragnarok and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 7/10. The lane is decided by how well you survive levels 1-3 and how you track Ragnarok's 100s.

edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 8.5/10, Olaf carry threat 8/10.
edits.after: Coinflip lane — difficulty 7/10, Olaf carry threat 8/10.
